<thought>We need the template ID for the sulfonamide formation step (amine + phenylsulfonyl chloride → sulfonamide). This template can be found by searching for a reaction that breaks an S‑Cl bond and forms an N‑S bond. We'll query the template catalog with those criteria.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1S(=O)(=O)Nc1ccccc1F",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["S-Cl"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["N-S"],
  "bonds_broken": ["S-Cl"],
  "bonds_formed": ["N-S"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
